snippet.title: Dark Adelita | First Look | indie.io
snippet.description:
Face the legends. Fight for your soul in Dark Adelita. 
Wishlist now ➤https://bit.ly/DarkAdelita

Dark Adelita is a brutal 2D action platformer rooted in Mexican folklore.
Play as Angela, a fearless Adelita drawn into a supernatural war across post-revolutionary Mexico. Battle mythic horrors like La Llorona and El Charro, dodge deadly traps, and descend into regions where legends rise from the ashes of history.

🪓 Tactical side-scrolling combat with brutal difficulty
👹 Boss battles inspired by Mexican folklore
🌄 Levels based on real regions: Yucatán, Jalisco, Sonora
🎨 Crisp pixel-art soaked in myth and atmosphere
🧠 A war fought with firepower, cunning and courage

The shadows whisper. The legends stir.
And Angela walks the haunted path once more.

Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q

#MexicanFolklore #indieGame #2DPlatformer #PixelArt #ActionGame #SteamGames #retrogaming
